scenes.title: Strange Payment
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev complains to Vika that a customs official paid him for hosting a party with a confiscated piano and coffin, while Vika reminds him she is away for the weekend.

scenes.title: The Filmmakers' Banquet
scenes.summary: Gavril Ilyich from the Filmmakers' Union arrives on behalf of director Nikita Mikhalkov to book a banquet at Claude Monet, specifically requesting Chef Viktor Barinov's cooking.

scenes.title: The Newcomer's Duty
scenes.summary: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, supplier Timur complains that nobody is unloading his produce crates, so the veteran cooks send newcomer Denis to accept the delivery.

scenes.title: The Voracious Dog
scenes.summary: While unloading chestnuts and gourmet squab pigeons in the courtyard, Denis feeds chicken bones to the stray dog Eleonora Andreyevna, who promptly devours the expensive pigeons.

scenes.title: Barinov's Condition
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev visits Arcobaleno to beg Viktor Barinov to appear as head chef at Claude Monet tonight, and Barinov agrees in exchange for kicking Nagiyev three times.

scenes.title: Hunting for Pigeons
scenes.summary: Denis confesses to Senya that the stray dog ate the gourmet pigeons, and when supplier Timur jokes that he should catch one on the street, Denis takes him literally.

scenes.title: The Chef's Apology
scenes.summary: Returning to the kitchen of Claude Monet, Viktor Barinov sincerely apologizes to his old brigade for the harsh words he said in the documentary film and calls them his closest family.

scenes.title: Two Chefs in One Kitchen
scenes.summary: German confronts Barinov in the kitchen, and in the office Nagiyev explains that German will cook the banquet food while Barinov only goes out to greet the guest.

scenes.title: The Culinary Bet
scenes.summary: Viktor Barinov bets German Land that the Filmmakers' Union guest will immediately notice Barinov did not cook the dish, with the loser becoming the winner's kitchen servant.

scenes.title: Barinov's Victory
scenes.summary: Gavril Ilyich takes one bite of German's dish and immediately realizes Barinov did not cook it, handing Barinov victory in the bet over German.

scenes.title: The First Payback
scenes.summary: Before cooking for Gavril Ilyich, Viktor Barinov collects the first of his three promised kicks from Dmitry Nagiyev and has Nagiyev introduce him in the dining room.

scenes.title: The Master at Work
scenes.summary: Back at the helm of the Claude Monet kitchen, Viktor Barinov rallies Fedya, Senya, and Louis to prepare a flawless banquet menu and marvels at how good it feels to be home.

scenes.title: Treacherous Vinegar
scenes.summary: Refusing to accept defeat, German corners Senya and pressures him into pouring vinegar into Barinov's finished onion soup by reminding Senya who will be boss tomorrow.

scenes.title: Sugar and a Live Pigeon
scenes.summary: Fedya catches Senya pouring vinegar into the soup, but Senya explains he can neutralize the acid with sugar, while Denis returns with a live street pigeon in a bag.

scenes.title: Senya's Secret Ingredient
scenes.summary: Fedya distracts German and Barinov so Senya can secretly spoon sugar into the onion soup to neutralize the vinegar, and the guest praises Barinov's main course.

scenes.title: Talents of the Restaurant
scenes.summary: Nagiyev shows off Denis playing the grand piano for Gavril Ilyich, while an actor whom Nagiyev had hired earlier to impersonate Barinov unexpectedly walks into the restaurant.

scenes.title: Triumph of the Onion Soup
scenes.summary: Gavril Ilyich tastes the onion soup and calls it fantastic, and when German storms out claiming the soup is sour with vinegar, he tastes it and is stunned by how delicious it is!

scenes.title: The Call to Mikhalkov
scenes.summary: Gavril Ilyich calls director Nikita Mikhalkov on the phone and lets Nagiyev speak to him, while Nagiyev begs Gavril Ilyich not to move the banquet to Arcobaleno.

scenes.title: The Pigeon Under the Cover
scenes.summary: When a waiter lifts the silver cloche in the dining room, the live street pigeon that Denis hid underneath flies out over Gavril Ilyich's table, ruining the banquet deal.

scenes.title: Forgiving a Friend
scenes.summary: At the end of the evening, Dmitry Nagiyev comes to honor his debt of two more kicks, and Viktor Barinov realizes he no longer wants to see his old friend humiliated.
